chunks: And from his sayings (peace be upon him): Dhi‘lib al-Yamāmī narrated from Aḥmad ibn Qutaybah, from ‘Abdullāh ibn Yazīd, from Mālik ibn Diḥyah, who said:
We were with Amīr al-mu’minīn (peace be upon him) when the differences of people were mentioned before him, so he said:
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the differences among people?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Nahj al-Balagha* by Sharif al-Radi, this narration from Imam ‘Alī (peace be upon him) addresses the root causes of human diversity in traits and conduct, offering a theological and sociological perspective on why people differ. It highlights the Imam’s insight into the interplay between divine decree and human nature, serving as a foundational text for understanding social cohesion and individual responsibility in Shia thought.
